verses.22:27: وَأَذِّن فِي ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَجِّ يَأۡتُوكَ رِجَالࣰ ا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرࣲ يَأۡتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقࣲ‏

meaning: The root عمق (Emq) refers to the bottom or depth of a well, valley, or similar. It can also describe the distant or remote extremity of a desert.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
